results.title: New Analysis opens Analysis Type with two cards and nothing selected

steps.title: When the user clicks New Analysis
steps.expected: The wizard opens on step 1 "Analysis Type"; the stepper lists 5 steps: Analysis Type, Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts, Review; the step subtitle reads "Choose what you want to measure"

steps.title: Then two cards "Brand analysis" and "Unbranded analysis" are displayed
steps.expected: Both cards are shown with their descriptions: Brand analysis "Measure how AI engines see, rank and compare your brand against its competitors." and Unbranded analysis "Measure an industry or a topic: which brands AI engines name, and what they say about it."; the Unbranded analysis card has no "No brand scorecard" point

results.notes: Dashboard of QA-GEO with New Analysis (pool 996 / 1000). New Analysis opens /geo/new on step 1 'Analysis Type'; stepper lists 5 steps: 'Analysis Type', 'Brand & Country', 'Categories', 'Prompts', 'Summary'. Step subtitle 'Choose what you want to measure' (exact). Card 'Brand analysis' (Default): 'Measure how AI engines see, rank and compare your brand against its competitors.' (exact) + 3 points. Card 'Unbranded analysis' (Advanced): 'Measure an industry or a topic: which brands AI engines name, and what they say about it.' (exact) + 2 points 'Who appears in this topic and where' / 'What the topic is judged on'; no 'No brand scorecard' point. Both radios aria-checked=false, Continue disabled. Known CSV gap pending GEO-1507: the CSV step 2 still lists the 5th step as 'Review'; the UI shows 'Summary' (= en-gb wizard.steps.review) - not counted as a failure.
csv_gaps: Step 2 expected result lists the 5th stepper step as 'Review'; UI shows 'Summary' (known gap pending GEO-1507)

results.notes: Same wizard draft (Postal services, GB (EN) + FR (FR), Package Delivery = C1, Mail Services = C2, 120 suggestions). As on 21/10: all rows unticked with the header checkbox (996 / 1000 · 0 selected), then 2 custom prompts added with Category left as Other and Type Visibility, GB (EN): 'Which courier offers the cheapest next-day delivery?' and 'Which postal service is most reliable for letters?' (998 / 1000 · 2 selected). Banner role=status shown above the table (banner y=231, table y=307): title '2 prompts are in Other.' and body 'Pick a category and a type. Anything left as Other still runs, but it returns key concepts only, no metrics.' (both exact, = en-gb otherBanner_other / otherBannerBody); 'uncategorised' appears nowhere on the step. 'Review & Launch' enabled (disabled=false, no aria-disabled). Classified both with Category 'Package Delivery' (C1): banner '1 prompt is in Other.' after the first, no banner after the second (only the table footnote 'A prompt left without a category or a type is saved in Other.' remains). Side note: during setup a click on the stepper 'Analysis Type' (Playwright name match on 'Type') left Prompts; the draft was resumed via Categories > Generate Prompts (0 selected kept, no data loss).
